_about: A made-up example of the facts film.js reads (SK.DATA.content) -- the real sample is local, because its pictures are third-party. figure (1-8 characters; a long one wraps onto two lines), subline (1-3 lines; *words* in asterisks are bold, the rest light; a line with no asterisks is all bold), cta and legal (optional), photo (a picture key, or '' for the brand's colour field), focus ([x, y] 0-1: the part of the photo to keep in the frame), product ({image, round} or null: round is the corner radius at 1080 px, 0 for a cut-out), logo ({image, light} or null: image reads on light grounds, light on dark ones), brand ({name, ground, accent, ink}), anchor ('top' or 'bottom': which edge the words sit on), align ('left' or 'center': with no product, or above a product in a vertical frame).
